title: Open worker slots and a shared runner pool
problem: TASK-0003 registered AGENT-01..05 on WINDOWS and AGENT-06..10 on WSL runners, binding each slot to a runner class. The owner wants slots that are open: no task, PR or action waits for a specific slot, and every runner is usable by every slot.

options.summary: Slots are unbound (runnerClass ANY); the 5 Windows + 5 WSL runners form one shared pool; heavy-build limits count the runner class the task requires
Keep each slot bound to a runner class (5 WINDOWS + 5 WSL slots)

rationale: Owner instruction (2026-09-25). A slot is capacity, not identity: the scheduler assigns any READY task to any idle eligible slot, and GitHub routes CI jobs to any free runner by label, so no work is tied to a particular agent. Invariants kept: one Manager; at most 10 active tasks and 1 per slot (DEC-0006); reservations, dependencies, exact-head CI and merge rules unchanged. The DEC-0006 heavy-build limits (WINDOWS 3 / WSL 3 / ANY 5) keep their values but are now counted per runner class required by the task, protecting the shared pool rather than a slot. AGENT_RECONFIGURE lets the Manager or owner change an idle slot; the persistent branches arena/agent-01..10 remain workspaces, not ownership of work.

reason.summary: Superseded by owner decision DEC-0017 (git-native task model): tasks are owned by the assigned agent and live on its branch. The shared 5 Windows + 5 WSL runner pool from this decision is carried forward unchanged in DEC-0017.
